name_hi: मिर्च का फल सड़न और शीर्षमरण (एन्थ्रेक्नोज़)
symptoms_en: Tender twigs die back from the tip; flowers drop and dry; the drying spreads down the stem and branches; affected plants bear few, poor fruits.
symptoms_hi: कोमल टहनियाँ सिरे से सूखती हैं; फूल झड़ते और सूखते हैं; सूखना तने और शाखाओं तक फैलता है; प्रभावित पौधे कम और खराब फल देते हैं।

symptoms_en.title: TNAU Agritech Portal, crop protection: diseases of chilli
symptoms_en.quote: As the fungus causes necrosis of tender twigs from the tip backwards the disease is called die-back Infection usually begins when the crop is in flower. Flowers drop and dry up.

management_en.title: TNAU Agritech Portal, crop protection: diseases of chilli
management_en.quote: Use of disease-free seeds is important in preventing the disease.

recipe_slugs.title: NITI Aayog: Empowering Farmers, Natural Farming Training Toolkit and Best Practices Guide
recipe_slugs.quote: Fungus/Virus control: Spray 3–4 days old buttermilk mixed with 100 litres of water
recipe_slugs.note: Natural-farming guide (NITI); the recipe is matched to the pest class, not tested on this crop in Malwa.

management_en: Use disease-free seed; the infection usually starts at flowering.
management_hi: रोगमुक्त बीज का उपयोग करें; संक्रमण आमतौर पर फूल आने पर शुरू होता है।
